title: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.03093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). translated_title: 一项关于混合检索、自然语言推理与开源大语言模型在科学声明验证中的实验研究
translated_abstract: 声明验证是判断源文本支持某个声明、与其矛盾，还是证据不足的任务。自然语言推理（NLI）模型可以判断单个句子是支持还是反驳某个声明，但当证据分散在多个句子中时，它们就会表现不佳。相反，大语言模型（LLM）可以进行跨句推理，但可能得出文本并不支持的结论。在这项实验研究中，我们测试了一种保守的融合规则是否能结合两者的优势，该规则仅当两个模型意见一致时才将声明标注为“支持”或“反驳”，否则默认为“证据不足”。我们基于SciFact和CliniFact构建了一个包含2,035个声明的基准数据集（858个支持，152个反驳，1,025个证据不足）。我们使用语义检索与词法检索（BM25）相结合的混合方法为每个声明检索最相关的前五个句子，该方法略优于单独使用任何一种方法。
tldr: 本研究提出一种保守融合规则，将NLI模型与开源LLM的判断相结合——仅当两者一致时才标注“支持”或“反驳”，否则判定“证据不足”，并配合语义与BM25混合检索，在SciFact和CliniFact构建的2,035个声明基准上验证了该方法在科学声明验证中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a conservative fusion rule that combines NLI models and open-source LLMs—labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both agree, otherwise defaulting to Not Enough Evidence—together with hybrid semantic-BM25 retrieval, validated on a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact for scientific claim verification.
